scientific_limitations: Macroscopic Thomas–Fermi hydrodynamic counting fraction only; microscopic finite-particle counting fluctuations omitted.
Global instantaneous Poisson resetting and exactly self-similar inverted-parabola initial cloud are assumed.
Limits are at fixed positive reset rate and fixed finite shell radii; no uniform coalescing-shell limit is proved.
Available literature comparisons are not an independent publication-priority determination.
title: Exterior-shell counting and a two-scale fold in a reset Thomas–Fermi condensate
